name: GemPadLock collectFees reentrancy
summary: collectFees() has no nonReentrant guard and pays out fee tokens before updating lock accounting, so a malicious token that re-enters during the fee transfer created free locks and let the attacker withdraw other projects' locked LP and tokens.
notes: The second and final pre-incident Upgraded event selected GemPadLock implementation 0xc25c516eb7d86b5ec38c07182f4a2f73ac81eead.

This transaction withdrew exactly 28,764.824728829399722296 FOMO-WETH UNI-V2 tokens. At the preceding block their pro-rata claim on the pair's WETH reserve alone was 5.624729835491078630 WETH, worth $22,564.29 at the nearest pre-incident price; the FOMO reserve is omitted, so the USD amount is a conservative transaction-specific partial valuation rather than the reported multichain total.
